messages:
Marin: Quick sync on the newsletter for the benchmark post + webinar — want a compact drip that feels less salesy. thinking: launch email + segmented resource follow-ups over 7 days.
Diego: agree. Keep the launch email short, then day 2 send a deep-dive for engaged opens, day 5 a 'missed the webinar' recap.
Nora: segmentation idea:
  - Warm (opened any last 30d OR trial active)
  - Cold (no opens 90d)
  - Engaged enterprise (company_size>250 & lead_score>70)
Make sure we suppress anyone who registered for the webinar.
Eli: deliverability checks: use single click-tracking domain, strip UTM on plain-text version, and keep image weight under 200kb.
Marin: Subject line variants for A/B (split 30/30/40):
  A) "Benchmarks: 3x inference throughput — see the results"
  B) "Lower cost, same quality — our benchmark breakdown + live demo"
  C) control = current newsletter subject (no change)
Diego: Preview text: "Live webinar + replay for engineers — register now"
Nora: CTA matrix: primary CTA -> webinar registration; secondary (warm/trial) -> start a free trial + migration checklist; tertiary (enterprise) -> request a demo.
Marin: Campaign-bot, create campaign skeleton and add these link templates:
```
/webinar?utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_segment={{segment}}&utm_source=newsletter
/try?utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_segment={{segment}}&utm_source=newsletter
/demo?utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_segment={{segment}}&utm_source=newsletter
```
campaign-bot: campaign created id=8921, draft saved, internal preview to team at 09:15 PST.
Eli: Ops note: add header X-Redwood-Campaign: benchmark_launch for tracking in backend logs. Also add query param lead_flag=enterprise for enterprise redirects.
Nora: For the reminder cadence: send only to non-openers and non-registrants. keep subject tweak: prepend "Reminder:" to original.
Diego: Measurement plan: opens, click-through rate, registrations, demo requests, and pipeline influenced (30d). Also compute CPReg by segment.
Marin: Post-webinar flow: immediate thank-you -> send replay + 1-click feedback (thumbs up/down) -> 3-day follow-up with relevant next step based on feedback.
Eli: Privacy check: ensure SMS/phone nudges only for contacts with sms_opt_in=true.
Nora: Copy brief: 1) one-sentence hook 2) 2 bullets (speed, cost) 3) quote from engineer 4) 1-line CTA 5) calendar-add link. I'll drop copy in thread by noon.
Marin: Final: run internal send to eng & sales at 09:15 tomorrow, then QA inboxes across Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail. Lock content by EOD today. :rocket:
